APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1.title: Documents to be Uploaded for EoA based on Self-Disclosure
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1.summary: Checklist of documents to be uploaded for issuance of EoA based on Self-Disclosure, after a break in preceding academic years, or restoration of intake, including Affidavit-2 (§2.1(i)), pay receipt if any (§2.1(ii)), building certificates (§2.1(iii)-(iv)), fire safety certificate (§2.1(v)), satellite map (§2.1(vi)), and audited accounts (§2.1(vii)).
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1.notes: Heading locator for Annexure-2 Section 2.1. In the checklist, only 2.1(ii) is worded 'if any'. Prototype scope covers representative document types per DECISIONS.md Q-002.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1.excerpt: Documents to be uploaded for the issuance of EoA based on Self-Disclosure/after a break in the preceding Academic Years/ Restoration of Intake

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_PREAMBLE.title: Government-Constructed Buildings Older than 50 Years Exception
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_PREAMBLE.summary: Provision permitting institutions with buildings constructed by Government Departments older than 50 years (as on last date of application) where original documents cannot be submitted, to produce a letter from the Competent Authority stating that AICTE building norms are fulfilled.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_PREAMBLE.notes: This 50-year exception is in the Annexure-2 §2.1 preamble, distinct from the Government Building Act, 1899 mentioned in Clause 6.17(g).
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_PREAMBLE.excerpt: In case of Buildings constructed by Government Departments are older than 50 years as on last date of application and the departments are unable to submit the original documents, a letter from the Competent Authority stating that the Building norms of AICTE are full filled, shall be produced to this effect.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_I.title: Affidavit-2 Submission Requirement
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_I.summary: Requirement to upload Affidavit-2 with digital signature of the Chairman/Secretary of the Trust/Society/Company on an e-stamp paper of Rs. 100/- duly sworn before a First Class Judicial Magistrate or Notary or an Oath Commissioner.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_I.excerpt: An Affidavit 2 with digital signature of the Chairman/ Secretary of the Trust/ Society/ Company on an e-stamp paper of Rs. 100/- duly sworn before a First Class Judicial Magistrate or Notary or an Oath Commissioner.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.title: AICTE Web-Portal Payment Receipt (if any)
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.summary: Copy of pay receipt print made on AICTE Web-Portal if any, in respect of Extension of Approval for the respective Academic Year.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.excerpt: Copy of pay receipt print made on AICTE Web-Portal if any, in respect of Extension of Approval for the respective Academic Year.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.title: Building Occupancy / Completion Certificate Requirement
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.summary: Requirement to upload valid Occupancy/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D issued by the Competent Authority as per referenced clause.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.notes: The clause text cites 'Clause 7.17 of the Approval Process Handbook'. Chapter VII runs 7.1-7.13, so no Clause 7.17 exists in the handbook text; the only occurrence of '7.17' is this Annexure-2 line. The occupancy norm is 6.17(g) (handbook p57, PDF 73), which appears to be the intended reference.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.cross_reference_notes: Annexure-2 §2.1(iii) cites 'Clause 7.17'. Chapter VII runs 7.1-7.13, so no Clause 7.17 exists in the handbook text; the only occurrence of '7.17' is this Annexure-2 line. The occupancy norm is 6.17(g) (handbook p57, PDF 73), which appears to be the intended reference.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.excerpt: As per Clause 7.17 of the Approval Process Handbook, valid Occupancy/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D issued by the Competent Authority.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.title: Structural Stability Certificate (> 30 Years)
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.summary: Requirement to upload valid Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer if the Building is more than thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate that the Building is fit for human habitation.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.excerpt: Valid Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer, if the Building is more than thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate that the Building is fit for human habitation.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.title: Valid Fire Safety Certificate Requirement
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.summary: Requirement to upload a valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.excerpt: A valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.

APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.title: TER Fee Schedule Table
APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.summary: Table 2.1 specifies Technical Education Regulatory (TER) Charges in Rs. Lakh across different types of institutions and categories of application including Extension of Approval based on Self-Disclosure and Break in EoA/Restoration of Intake.
APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.notes: Heading locator only; does not specify a flat 100,000 INR requirement or online portal payment mechanism directly on the table header.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.title: Occupancy Certificate & Government Building Act, 1899
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.summary: Occupancy Certificate/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D (as applicable) shall be obtained from the Competent Authority (as per standard format prescribed by the issuing Authority). For Government Buildings, the Government Building Act, 1899 is applicable.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.notes: Clause 6.17(g) explicitly governs Government Buildings under the Government Building Act, 1899. Annexure-2 §2.1(iii) cross-reference '7.17' apparently refers to this clause.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_G.excerpt: Occupancy Certificate/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D (as applicable) shall be obtained from the Competent Authority (as per standard format prescribed by the issuing Authority). For Government Buildings, the Government Building Act, 1899 is applicable.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_H.title: Structural Stability Certificate Validity and 30-Year Rule
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_H.summary: After the expiry of a period of thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate, a Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer for the purpose of certifying that the Building is safe for human habitation shall be produced. Structural Stability Certificate is valid for a period of FIVE years from the date of issue.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_H.excerpt: After the expiry of a period of thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate, a Structural Stability Certificate from the registered Structural Engineer for the purpose of certifying that the Building is safe for human habitation shall be produced. Structural Stability Certificate is valid for a period of FIVE years from the date of issue.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_I.title: Valid Fire Safety Certificate Requirement
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_I.summary: A valid Fire Safety Certificate shall be obtained from the Competent Authority.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_I.excerpt: A valid Fire Safety Certificate shall be obtained from the Competent Authority.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_J.title: Competent Authorities Pertaining to Land/Building
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_J.summary: State wise Competent Authorities for issuing the Certificates pertaining to the Land/ Building including Occupancy Certificate as given in Annexure-14 of the Approval Process Handbook.
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_6_17_J.excerpt: State wise Competent Authorities for issuing the Certificates pertaining to the Land/ Building including Occupancy Certificate as given in Annexure-14 of the Approval Process Handbook.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_3_CLAUSE_3_1_D.title: Fire Department Certificate Requirement
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_3_CLAUSE_3_1_D.summary: Fire and life Safety Certificate from Fire Department of the concerned State Government authority is to be taken before submitting the application at AICTE.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_3_CLAUSE_3_1_D.excerpt: Fire and life Safety Certificate from Fire Department of the concerned State Government authority is to be taken before submitting the application at AICTE.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_14.title: State Wise Competent Authorities Table
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_14.summary: Annexure-14 lists state-wise competent authorities to issue certificates with respect to Land/Building across four columns: Land use Certificate, Site Plan, Building Plan, and Occupation Certificate.
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_14.notes: Heading locator only. Annexure-14 has no fire-authority column; fire issuer plausibility is checked at state fire department level only per Annexure-3 §3.1(d) and Clause 6.17(i).
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_14.excerpt: State Wise Competent Authorities to issue Certificates with Respect to the Land/ Building

APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2.title: Format of Affidavit-2
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2.summary: Format of Affidavit-2 for applications submitted under Chapter I/II/IV (except Closure of the Institution) affirming compliance with AICTE norms, infrastructure declarations, and document uploads.
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2.notes: Heading locator only. The Affidavit spans multiple pages (PDF 202-204, handbook pages 186-188) containing affirmation clauses (items 1-15 on handbook page 186 / PDF 202, continuing with items 16-33 and land/built-up area tables on subsequent pages) followed by formal verification. Specific declarations regarding certificate uploads are contained in items 5 and 7 on PDF 202.
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2.excerpt: AFFIDAVIT-2 (For the applications submitted under Chapter I/II/IV except Closure of the Institution)

APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_5.title: Affidavit-2 Declaration of Occupancy and Structural Stability Certificates
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_5.summary: Declaration affirming upload of the Occupancy/Completion Certificate/Building License/Form D issued by the Competent Authority and the Structural Stability Certificate by the Competent Authority.
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_5.notes: Item 5 says 'Structural Stability Certificate by the Competent Authority', while Annexure-2 §2.1(iv) says 'registered Structural Engineer'; this is a wording difference in the handbook.
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_5.excerpt: That I/we have uploaded the Occupancy/Completion Certificate/Building License/Form D issued by the Competent Authority and the Structural Stability Certificate by the Competent Authority;

APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_7.title: Affidavit-2 Declaration of Valid Fire Safety Certificate
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_7.summary: Declaration affirming upload of valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2_ITEM_7.excerpt: That I/we have uploaded valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority;
